## ReadKey type

One key of entity `N` as `read` takes it: the key, typed by the entity's key schema; or, for an entity that declares `context` attributes (only a base row or a link brings them, never a hydrator), `{ key, carries }` with every one of them, and any other carried attribute the row already knows.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type ReadKey<E extends Entities, N extends keyof E> = E[N] extends Entity<infer K, infer C, infer X, infer KIn> ? [X] extends [never] ? KeyInput<K, KIn> : {
    readonly key: KeyInput<K, KIn>;
    readonly carries: Flat<{
        readonly [A in X]: C[A];
    } & {
        readonly [A in Exclude<keyof C, X>]?: C[A];
    }>;
} : never;
```
